name: NullBeat
author: Fraser Simpson
description: Streams and downloads through NullBeat, with cache-aware matching, automatic upcoming-queue preparation and persistent playback statistics.

actions.name: audio.source
actions.why: Streams matched recordings through your NullBeat Eclipse addon.

actions.name: download.source
actions.why: Downloads matched recordings through your NullBeat Eclipse addon.

actions.name: network
actions.why: Connects to the HTTPS NullBeat addon URL you configure.

actions.name: settings.page
actions.why: Stores your private addon URL and tests the connection.

actions.name: playback.events
actions.why: Tracks playback and prepares upcoming queue entries.

actions.name: notify
actions.why: Shows connection-test results and actionable setup errors in Orpheon.

actions.name: storage
actions.why: Saves playback statistics between app sessions.

settings.label: NullBeat manifest URL
settings.description: Paste the complete HTTPS manifest.json URL generated by NullBeat. Keep the token-bearing URL private.

settings.label: Additional tracks to precache
settings.description: Precache this many extra upcoming tracks in addition to the default one-track-ahead preparation. Set from 0 to 4.

settings.label: Cache-only mode
settings.description: Request NullBeat/TorBox cache preparation during downloads, but do not return a downloadable file.

settings.label: Test NullBeat connection
settings.description: Checks the manifest and performs a small sample search.

settings.label: View playback statistics
settings.description: Shows total plays, NullBeat streams and downloads, completed tracks, skips and listening time.

settings.label: Reset playback statistics
settings.description: Permanently resets the statistics stored by this extension.

welcome.message: Routes Orpheon streaming and downloads through one NullBeat Eclipse addon. NullBeat remains responsible for selecting audio quality; this extension adds no duplicate quality setting.
steps: Open the extension settings in Orpheon.
Paste your complete NullBeat manifest.json URL into the single URL field.
Press Test NullBeat connection, then play or download a track.

changelog: 1.1.10: Limit additional queue precaching setting to 0–4. 1.1.9: Add a setting for 0–5 additional upcoming tracks to precache on top of the default one-track-ahead preparation. 1.1.8: Add download-hook, resolver-response and Revera handoff diagnostics (media URLs are never logged). 1.1.7: Add artist-only search and scored fuzzy title/artist validation using duration and album ranking. 1.1.6: Add bounded expanded search fallbacks with strict artist/title/duration validation and album-aware ranking; stop extra searches on rate limits. 1.1.5: Add ordered ISRC, exact artist + title, and cleaned artist + title matching fallbacks. 1.1.4: Improve intermittent track matching across NullBeat response variants and artist metadata shapes. 1.1.3: Retry transient track-search/network failures once and log whether resolution failed due to HTTP errors or no matching catalogue result. 1.1.2: Fix automatic queue preparation to read Revera track title/artist fields and log queue matching diagnostics. 1.1.1: Automatically prepare the next five published queue tracks when Revera queue updates; remove manual queue button. 1.1.0: Add manual Spotify queue fetching and parallel preparation of up to five upcoming tracks. 1.0.9: Add an optional cache-only download mode. 1.0.8: Add artist and title fallback matching when exact recording matching fails. 1.0.7: Remove the download provider field so no provider label is displayed. 1.0.6: Remove the TorBox cached label from downloaded tracks; provider displays as NullBeat. 1.0.5: Add persistent playback statistics and controls to view or reset the counters. 1.0.4: Log Orpheon's ahead request immediately when the hook receives it.
